g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access Send POST /api/Users with email, password, passwordRepeat and role=admin, with no credentials. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Privileged attributes lack an enforced write allowlist (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters An unauthenticated caller sends GET /rest/products/search?q= with a quote-closing UNION payload at routes/search.ts:23. The q value is concatenated into a raw SQL string, so the caller can read other tables such as Users, including emails and password hashes, which come back in the JSON product list. The only control is truncation of q to 200 characters, and the route has no authentication. The scanner finding at the same location also notes that interpolating request text into SQL can allow modifying rows or escalating to full database control. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Stored input run as server-side code Register or update my profile with username #{process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id')}. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Stored input run as server-side code

g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication getUserId reads the bearer token and calls security.decode, which is jws.decode without signature verification, then uses data.id as the caller identity. An attacker forges an unsigned or self-signed token carrying another user's id and calls POST /rest/chat; the getOrderById tool then returns that user's orders (LLM06, ASI03). C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets A request-controlled path with `../` can read arbitrary files (/etc/passwd, source, secrets) or write outside the intended root. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers An attacker sends a link whose q query parameter holds script markup. The search component (frontend/src/app/search-result/search-result.component.ts:143) marks it as trusted HTML and writes it into the page heading with innerHTML, so script runs in the victim's origin and can read or steal the JWT stored in localStorage. No control exists on this path, and no CSP was evidenced in the sources read. C-05 · frontend client application No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-008) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs The npmrc disables lockfile generation, so CI, release packaging and Docker builds run npm install against floating semver ranges. An attacker who publishes a malicious version of a direct or transitive package, or compromises a maintainer account, gets it installed in release artifacts and in jobs holding secrets, with no diff signal. C-02 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Build pipeline trusts mutable third-party references (W-037) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
